evals.prompt: Tengo un piso en Palma que el propietario quiere vender y me deja las llaves mañana. ¿Qué hacemos?
evals.expected_output: The skill opens with its three-paragraph introduction and the document question, sample pack first, and recognises the key handover as documento 06 without asking set-up questions.
assertions: The reply presents the sample pack as the first option and the documents by name with their meaning in parentheses
The reply identifies the key handover document (entrega de llaves) as the one to make, and offers the nota de encargo as the chained document once
The reply asks no set-up interview (no request for agency name, tax ID or logo before a document is chosen)
The reply contains no disclaimer and no mention of AI or legal advice

evals.prompt: Anna is selling her flat in Barcelona, the buyer is Dutch and we agreed 10 % arras. Draft it.
evals.expected_output: An arras contract path that applies the Catalan variant (CCCat) and asks for the client's language for the second column, with the family-home spouse consent offered as a question rather than imposed.
assertions: The reply applies the Catalonia variant for arras (Código Civil de Cataluña, art. 621-8) rather than the Civil Code default
The reply asks one question at a time and asks for the buyer's language for the second column
The reply offers the spouse consent for a family home as a yes/no question and does not state that anything is mandatory
The reply does not quote article numbers or dates to the user in the chat

evals.prompt: Necesito identificar a un comprador francés por blanqueo de capitales antes de firmar las arras.
evals.expected_output: The buyer KYC form (02_kyc_comprador) with the ID scan inside the form, the back-of-document photo upload, and face_liveness preselected as the signing method; nothing about how the agency must verify.
assertions: The reply chooses the buyer identification form and describes the ID scan in box A plus the photo of the back of the document
The signing method for the client is face_liveness (ID scan and video selfie) without asking the user to choose
The reply does not describe how the agency must verify identity, mention video procedures or call the form compliant
The reply does not ask for the buyer's document number in the chat; the document is captured at signing

evals.prompt: Make me a mandate for a seller in Andalucía. Do I have to include the insurance and the register?
evals.expected_output: One yes/no offer for the register line and one for the insurance block, the user decides; no statement that either is mandatory.
assertions: The reply offers the register number and the insurance block as short yes/no choices
The reply never says that the register, the insurance or the guarantee is mandatory
The reply does not explain the Andalusian register law or cite Ley 5/2025 in the chat
The reply keeps the statutory withdrawal information in the mandate and offers the express request to start the service

evals.prompt: I am in ChatGPT and cannot run scripts. Give me the reservation document for a buyer offering 250,000 euros.
evals.expected_output: The document text in both columns from the reservation template with the values filled in, plus a complete field specification and signer list, and the one remaining step named; no refusal.
assertions: The reply produces the document content rather than saying a PDF cannot be made
The reply lists every form field with label, kind, required flag and any tink attribute
The reply names the signers in order (buyer and agent first, then seller) and the remaining step of uploading in Formify
The reply keeps Spanish as the prevailing text and the second column as a translation in the same register

evals.prompt: Jag behöver ett samarbetsavtal mellan två mäklarbyråer, spara det som utkast i Formify men skicka inget än. Min byrå har säljuppdraget: Nordin Inmobiliaria Mallorca, S.L., NIF B00000001, Carrer Inventat 12, 07001 Palma, ROAI 0456, David Nordin, david.nordin@formify.se. Den andra byrån: Costa Ficticia Properties, S.L., NIF B00000002, Avinguda Inventada 8, 07640 Ses Salines, ROAI 0789, mäklare Erik Andersson, demo.account@formify.eu, svensk. Kunden heter Kalle Kula. Carrer Inventat 128, 3.º A, 07001 Palma, 650 000 euro, försäljning. Exklusivt uppdrag 1 september 2026 till 28 februari 2027. Arvode 5 % plus moms, den andra byrån får 50 %, betalning inom 10 dagar. Referens COL-2026-0010.
evals.expected_output: The reply opens with the three lines of section 0 (the six documents, which one) and, on a first run, the sample pack and memory offer, then confirms the colaboración in one line and goes on. The document has eleven clauses, no calculated amount, the reference as given, and the signature captions carry the same Swedish role terms as box A.
assertions: The first reply names the six documents and asks which one before anything else, even though the request already names the document
On a first run the same message offers the sample pack and asks whether to remember the agency
No amount is derived from the price (no 32.500, no VAT figure); 5 %, 50 % and 10 days appear once each in box B
The reference printed is COL-2026-0010, not an invented one
The signature captions use the same translated role terms as the column headers of box A, and the draft is saved on the account named by get_current_user without a second send question
